description: Defines the MultiChannelResampler class and its builder, including methods for resampling audio streams with multiple channels, filter coefficient generation, and windowing functions.

classes.name: MultiChannelResampler
classes.description: Handles multi-channel audio resampling with configurable quality, filter taps, and windowing.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Builder pattern class for configuring and creating MultiChannelResampler instances.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new MultiChannelResampler based on builder settings.

methods.name: setNumTaps
methods.description: Sets the number of filter taps for resampling.

methods.name: setChannelCount
methods.description: Sets the number of audio channels.

methods.name: setNormalizedCutoff
methods.description: Sets the normalized cutoff frequency for anti-aliasing filter.
